name: AnchorPicker
description: Nine-position image-space anchor picker, with roving arrow-key focus.

name: BalanceWheel
description: Push one tonal range towards a colour: the hue is the direction and the distance from the centre is how far.

name: BasicAdjustments
description: A host can render just one slider, without a provider or an editor.

name: BasicPanel
description: Session binding over BasicAdjustments; committed changes use edit.apply.

name: BatchPanel
description: Choose local files and run an injected renderer with per-file results.

name: BeforeAfter
description: Public comparison on Glass UX CompareSlider; image coordinates always stay left-to-right.

name: BlendModeSelect
description: All sixteen linear-light blend modes.

name: BrushCursor
description: Two outlined rings show size and hardness; image coordinates remain left-to-right.

name: BrushPicker
description: Size, hardness, opacity, flow and optional colour, using Glass UX controls.

name: ColourBalancePanel
description: Shadow, midtone and highlight colour-balance wheels.

name: CurvesEditor
description: An image-specific spline graph; Glass UX fields expose every point to keyboard users.

name: DetailPanel
description: Saved-input clarity, texture and dehaze.

name: DevelopBasicPanel
description: Full Basic section: histogram, linear exposure, tone, white balance and colour.

name: DevelopCompare
description: Glass UX's keyboard-operable comparison; both sides share the current geometry.

name: DevelopCompareOverlay
description: PhotoEditor overlay, toggled by the Basic section's comparison button.

name: DevelopLevelsPanel
description: Session-bound master and per-channel levels.

name: EffectsStackPanel
description: Duplicate effects can be reordered, blended, edited and removed with intercepted labelled actions.

name: ExportPanel
description: Standalone export controls and the exact encoded preview/file size.

name: FilesPanel
description: Session-bound open, clipboard, native project and recovery actions supplied by host file adapters.

name: Filmstrip
description: A horizontally scrolling single-choice Glass UX toolbar, with arrow keys and named thumbnails.

name: FilterGallery
description: Worker-rendered thumbnails; the source reader is debounced and cancelled on replacement.

name: FilterGalleryPanel
description: Session-bound effect candidates with worker-rendered thumbnails; selection commits an intercepted action.

name: HistogramPanel
description: Glass UX Histogram fed by readPreview, including uncommitted slider drafts.

name: HistoryPanel
description: Glass UX Tree supplies roving focus and arrow-key branch navigation; selection jumps via edit.goTo.

name: HslPanel
description: Eight colour ranges with smoothly overlapping hue, saturation and luminance adjustments.

name: ImageCanvas
description: The accelerated view of the nearest editor.

name: ImageEditor
description: Own a session for one source, or use ImageEditorView for a host-owned collection.

name: ImageEditorProvider
description: Provide an existing host-owned session to descendant editor parts; does not create or dispose it.

name: ImageEditorView
description: A full workspace made from public parts; no persistence or file transport is implicit.

name: LayersPanel
description: Glass UX tree with thumbnails, drag reorder, Alt+Arrow reorder, F2 rename, row menus and masks.

name: LevelsEditor
description: Keyboard-accessible input endpoints, gamma and output endpoints, using Glass UX fields.

name: MetadataPanel
description: Read-only metadata and profile descriptions from plain host values, without a session.

name: PhotoEditor
description: A window-sized photo editor.

name: PhotoEditorActions
description: Undo and redo, for the title bar or a window's own action slot.

name: PhotoEditorStatus
description: Size and zoom, for the bottom bar or a window's own status slot.

name: PhotoEditorView
description: `PhotoEditor` over a session the host already holds, for when something outside needs it too.

name: PresetsPanel
description: Keyboard-operable preset list on the shared Tree.

name: RetouchOverlay
description: Direct DOM cursor updates; at most one recipe preview per animation frame.

name: RetouchPanel
description: Brush controls and the parameters specific to one retouch kernel.

name: SessionBatchPanel
description: Replay the current session recipe for independent files through an intercepted batch action.

name: SessionBlendModeSelect
description: Edits the selected layer through an intercepted, labelled action.

name: SessionExportPanel
description: Session export controls with a compressed preview and host-controlled delivery.

name: SessionLayersPanel
description: Image import, masks and baking use public session actions; the view itself remains reusable.

name: SessionMetadataPanel
description: Read original source metadata from an explicit session or its provider.

name: SessionPresetsPanel
description: Choosing a preset starts again: it runs `edit.restart`, so the preset applies to the picture as it was opened, earlier steps leave the history, and Undo returns to the original.

name: SessionTextOverlay
description: Click an existing glyph layer to edit it, or the stage to place a new one.

name: SessionTextPanel
description: Styling for the selected text, or defaults for the next text layer.

name: TextEditor
description: Native text composition remains intact for IMEs; newline inserts a line, Escape cancels.

name: TextPanel
description: Font controls use document pixels.

name: ToneCurvePanel
description: Session-bound RGB and per-channel tone curves.

name: ToolLabel
description: Public presentation bridge, useful to hosts building action labels from tool descriptors.

name: ToolRail
description: One single-choice toolbar; large kits group by public tool family.

name: ToolSettings
description: A tool's public Panel or collapsible Sections, independently of either editor composition.

name: TransformTarget
description: Target selector shared by the geometry tools.
